instruction: An oversized chess bishop cast in flawless optical crystal, its turned profile flowing from a wide disc base through a slender collared stem to a slit-notched mitre finial. The glass is water-clear with faint blue-green edge tint, refracting internal caustics and pinching light along the mitre slot. A polished sphere caps the very top.
